blind.description: A stylized wooden mining tool rack composed of a vertical timber backboard supported by two sturdy end-posts on floor runners. Hanging from upper pegs are two pickaxes, a shovel, and a large sledgehammer. A lower wooden shelf holds three metal ingots and a coiled rope. The geometry is solid, stylized, and continuous with painted wood grain and dark metal finishes.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular profile oriented vertically, showing the top square caps of the wooden posts, protruding hanging pegs, pickaxe head contours, the coiled rope circle, and the rectangular lower shelf with metal blocks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.8 to 4 ft tall) and roughly half as wide as the figure is tall (around 3 ft wide).
